name: kload
description: Load declared knowledge into native Codex skills and agents while keeping Claude definitions as the authored source.

interface.shortDescription: Shared agent definitions with verified knowledge delivery.
interface.longDescription: Registers generated Codex skills and agents, loads their declared knowledge at invocation, and records delivery hashes. Claude model settings stay with Claude; Codex models inherit unless overridden.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check kload's shared agents, skills, and knowledge delivery.
